title: Audit filter block layout percentages
description: Analyze how each filter block can declare width percentages, row placement, responsive behavior, and auto-packing inside the widget.
objective: Define a layout engine that lets filters sit beside each other predictably instead of forcing every block into full rows.
inputs_required: Guilherme request for per-filter percentage widths and automatic row packing
expected_outputs: Responsive packing risks and recommended control model
acceptance_criteria: The audit covers the block wrapper around every filter type and sort separately.
The audit defines whether width is a Content property, Style property, or both.
The audit accounts for desktop/tablet/mobile behavior and wrapping.
The audit identifies how presets store and restore layout widths.
verification: CSS and render selectors are cited.
No layout implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: Elementor responsive controls, filter wrappers, frontend CSS
budgets.research_budget: local code and Elementor control API

risks: Percent widths can create hidden overflow unless min-width, flex-wrap, gap, and responsive rules are designed together.
